user.title: Energydash
user.description: Energydash is added to the sidebar. There you choose your electricity price and meters, and add your devices.

reconfigure.title: Set up again
reconfigure.description: Prices and meters are in the Energydash panel, under Settings. Here you can clear calculated data or start completely fresh.

data_description.reset: Devices and price settings stay unless you choose to start fresh. Everything is recalculated over the history afterward.

create_entry.default: Energydash is set up. Open it in the sidebar to choose your electricity price.

options.all: Start fresh: remove devices and data

rest_cost_today.name: Rest of the house cost today

missing_entity.title: Energydash cannot find {entity_id}
missing_entity.description: The entity {entity_id} no longer exists. Choose another source in Energydash or restore the entity.

net_meter.title: Your import meter also counts down
net_meter.description: The meter {entity_id} went down several times in the last 2 days. This happens with a single net meter that counts down while you export. Energydash reads a drop as a new counter, so costs come out too high. In Energydash, under Settings, choose separate counters for import from the grid and export to the grid. Most smart meter integrations provide both.

recalculate.name: Recalculate
recalculate.description: Replaces calculated results with a recalculation over the recorder history (usually 10 days) and the long-term statistics before it.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: ID of an Energydash device. Leave empty for all devices and the house.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Clears calculated data, or also removes all devices.

scope.name: What to clear
scope.description: Only the calculated data, or the devices as well.
